orchestrator_output.text_narration:
• Rainwater harvesting is the process of collecting and storing rainwater for future use.

• It helps in conserving water and reducing the demand on groundwater.

• The collected rainwater can be used for drinking, irrigation, and other household purposes.

• It is an eco-friendly practice that can help in managing water scarcity.

• Rainwater harvesting systems can be simple, like collecting water in barrels, or more complex, like underground tanks.
